newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's interest rates appropriate - PBOC's Dai.
newsitem.headline: China's interest rates appropriate - PBOC's Dai.

text.p: China's present interest rates are appropriate, the Governor of the People's Bank of China, Dai Xianglong, said at a conference in Hong Kong on Friday.

"I can only tell you the present interest rate, to depositors and lenders, to the financial community, is appropriate," Dai told an International Monetary Fund (IMF)-Hong Kong Monetary Authority conference.
"Last year, in May and August, we sharply cut interest rates and it has hit the target," Dai said.
The People's Bank of China serves as China's central bank.
